zh.reply_args: <编号> "细节" --summary "一句结论" --status 已做 --orig "用户原话"
zh.meta_line: {use}{level}{desc} 按住拖动画布，触控板两指滑动也能移，捏合或按住 ⌘ 滚轮缩放；点节点展开或收起，右栏看说明、写反馈。写完反馈，在会话里对 AI 说一声「去看反馈」，它会取回、逐条回复；页面是静态文件，回复或更新后要刷新才看得到（⌘R）。生成于 {stamp}。
zh.search_hint_default: 搜索节点标题、说明、来源
zh.fb_placeholder: 想说什么直接写，不引用也行。要针对某一条：点节点右上角橙色的 💬，或在详情、大纲里选中一段字点「引用」。
zh.fb_hint: ⌘ + 回车 交；草稿自动存着
zh.btn_copy_title: 后备：把还没回复的反馈整理成一段字放进剪贴板，到会话里粘贴发出。平时不用，写完在会话里说一声「去看反馈」，AI 会来取；换了浏览器时用它
zh.cp_text: 请按 ⌘C 复制下面这段（已经选中了），到会话里粘贴发出。
zh.legend_suffix: 上次你看之后新增或改过的节点；ⓘ 有详细说明，点节点在右栏看；「+N」是收起的下级数量，旁边的小点表示收起的下级里有要你定（粉）、没看的回复（红）、改过的（紫）；橙色「💬N」是你在这一条上写过几条反馈，红点表示有没看的回复。
zh.node_fb_title: 你在这一条上交过的反馈
zh.children_head: 下一级（{n} 项，点一下跳过去）
zh.hits_found: 找到 {n} 处，回车跳下一处
zh.hits_at: 第 {i} / {n} 处，回车跳下一处
zh.chip_revising: 正在改之前交出去的 {id}，交了会注明是改写
zh.toast_not_found: 图里找不到这一条了，可能改过名
zh.item_ctx: 没引用；交的时候选中的是「{x}」
zh.item_sent: 已复制给 AI（{when}）。AI 回复后刷新这页，回复会显示在这里
zh.item_unsent: 只存在这个浏览器里；在会话里说一声「去看反馈」，AI 会来取、回复。回复后刷新这页
zh.empty_p1: 想针对某一条，就把鼠标移到图上那个节点，点右上角橙色的 💬；或者点开节点，在上面的详情里点「引用这一条去反馈」。
zh.empty_p2: 只想引其中一句：在详情或大纲视图里选中那段字，点弹出来的「引用这段」。可以引好几处，也可以一处都不引，直接写。
zh.empty_p3: 写完后在会话里告诉 AI 一声，它会来取、逐条回复；回复后刷新这页，回复会显示在对应那条下面。
zh.conn_bad: 这个窗口存不住，关掉就没了；请用浏览器打开这个文件，或写完马上复制给 AI
zh.toast_need_text_quoted: 引用好了，再写一句你想说的
zh.confirm_delete_sent: 这条已经复制给 AI 了，只是从这个浏览器里删掉，确定吗？
zh.confirm_submit_first: 输入框里还有没交的话，先把它交了再复制吗？
zh.toast_all_copied: 都复制过或已经回复了；要再发一遍点「全部再复制一次」
zh.toast_copied: 已复制 {n} 条，到会话里粘贴发出就行
zh.newver_title: 页面文件已经重新生成过，点一下刷新
zh.con_ask_title: 需要你回话或动手的事：「{now}」分支里标了「要你定」的，加上 AI 在回复里向你提的问题
zh.con_new_title: 你还没看过的 AI 回复；在右栏里露出来 2 秒就算看过
zh.con_chg_title: 和你上次看这张图时相比，标题、状态、说明变了或新增的节点
zh.flt_banner: 只看「{name}」：{n} 个节点（连同它们的上级）。
zh.sd_ask: 收起的下级里有要你定的
zh.sd_unread: 收起的下级里有没看的回复
zh.sd_chg: 收起的下级里有上次之后改过的
zh.node_threads: 这一条上的反馈（{n}，点一下到右栏）
zh.act_dismiss_title: 不用回了，或者已经在别处说过了
zh.sec_ask_hint: 点「回这条」写你的决定；AI 取回后会回复，这一条才会消失。
zh.chip_replyto: 正在回答 AI 的提问：{x}
zh.export_answers: （回答 AI 的提问，对应反馈 {id}）
zh.toast_seen: 已标为已看，下次打开只显示这之后的变化
zh.pop_ask_hint: 点一条跳到节点；回答就在右栏写反馈
zh.pop_new_hint: 在右栏看到 2 秒会自动变已读
zh.pop_chg_hint: 和你 {when} 看的那一次比
zh.pop_chg_none: 和你上次看的比，没有变化。
zh.pop_next_title: 接下来的时间点（还没到的 {n} 个）
zh.pop_next_none: 「接下来的时间点」里没有还没到的了。

en.meta_line: {use}{level}{desc} Drag to pan; pinch, or hold Ctrl/⌘ and scroll, to zoom. Click a node to select and expand it, and click it again to collapse it. Notes and feedback are in the right panel. When you have written feedback, tell the AI in your chat to “pull my feedback”: it fetches the feedback and replies to each item. The page is a static file, so refresh it (Ctrl/⌘ + R) to see replies and updates. Generated {stamp}.
en.fb_placeholder: Write whatever you like; quoting is optional. To point at a node, hover over it and click the orange 💬 at its corner, or select some text in the details or outline and click “Quote this”.
en.btn_copy_title: Fallback: put the feedback that has no reply yet on the clipboard as one block of text, to paste into your chat. Normally you do not need it: after writing, tell the AI to “pull my feedback” and it fetches it. Use this if you switched browsers.
en.cp_text: The text below is already selected. Press ⌘C (Ctrl+C) to copy it, then paste it into your chat.
en.legend_suffix: = added or edited since you last looked; ⓘ = has notes or sources (click the node to read them); “+N” = collapsed nodes below, and the small dots next to it mean that below there is something that needs you (pink), an unseen reply (red) or an edit (purple); orange “💬N” = feedback you wrote on this node, and a red dot means an unseen reply.
en.node_quote_title: Quote this node in your feedback
en.node_fb_title: Feedback you have written on this node

children_head.one: Next level (1 item, click to jump)
children_head.other: Next level ({n} items, click to jump)

en.quote_goto_title: Click to find it in the map
en.chip_revising: Revising {id}, which you already copied for AI; it will be marked as a revision.
en.toast_not_found: That node is no longer in the map; it may have been renamed.
en.item_ctx: No quote. The node selected when you wrote this: “{x}”
en.item_sent: Copied for AI ({when}). After the AI replies, refresh this page and the reply will show up here.
en.item_unsent: Saved only in this browser. Tell the AI in your chat to “pull my feedback”: it fetches and replies. Refresh this page after it replies.
en.act_edit_title: Move it back to the input box to edit
en.empty_p1: To point at one node, hover over it on the map and click the orange 💬 at its top-right corner, or click the node and press “Quote this node” in the details above.
en.empty_p2: To quote a single sentence, select it in the details or the outline view and click the “Quote this” button that pops up. You can quote several places, or none and just write.
en.empty_p3: When you have written something, tell the AI in your chat to “pull my feedback”: it fetches the feedback and replies to each item. After it replies, refresh this page and the reply appears under the matching item.
en.conn_bad: Can't save in this window; open the file in a regular browser
en.toast_need_text_quoted: Quote added. Now write what you want to say.
en.confirm_delete_sent: This one was already copied for the AI. It will only be deleted from this browser. Continue?
en.confirm_submit_first: The input box has text that isn't added yet. OK adds it and copies it too; Cancel copies without it.
en.toast_all_copied: Everything has been copied or replied to already. To copy it all again, click “Copy everything again”.

toast_copied.one: Copied 1 item. Paste it into your chat.
toast_copied.other: Copied {n} items. Paste them into your chat.

en.export_reply: Write replies back to the page: {cmd}
en.export_noquote: (no quote; the node selected when written: {path})
en.newver_title: The page file has been regenerated; click to refresh
en.con_ask_title: Things that need your answer or action: nodes tagged “Needs you” in the “{now}” branch, plus the questions the AI asked in its replies
en.con_new_title: AI replies you have not seen yet; a reply counts as seen once it has been visible in the right panel for 2 seconds
en.con_chg_title: Nodes whose title, status or note changed, or that are new, since you last looked at this map
en.con_doing_title: Items tagged “In progress” in the “{now}” branch
en.sd_chg: Edits below since you last looked
en.node_threads: Feedback on this node ({n}; click one to open it in the right panel)
en.item_noreply: The AI has not replied yet
en.act_dismiss_title: No answer needed, or already said elsewhere
en.sec_ask_hint: Click “Answer this” to write your decision; once the AI has pulled it and replied, this item goes away.
en.chip_replyto_title: This is not an answer to that question
en.toast_seen: Marked as seen; next time you open the page only later changes will show.
en.pop_ask_hint: Click an item to jump to the node; write your answer as feedback in the right panel
en.pop_new_hint: A reply you see in the right panel for 2 seconds is marked as read
en.pop_chg_hint: Compared with when you looked at {when}
en.pop_chg_none: No changes since you last looked.
en.pop_next_hint: Click an item to jump to the node
en.pop_next_none: No upcoming time is left in that group.
